question: Use only the bundled MPRINT snapshot revision 4bdee90dff3610816e86d0eed29b4c4d0fe76e89. This is a dataset audit, not a treatment or safety question. Run a levetiracetam search with population=neonate and study_type=CT, and restrict the candidate set to its first nine descending-PMID Gold records. The broad search band can return Children and mixed maternal/neonatal labels. Inspect the original population fields and keep the candidate labeled solely Neonatal. Read its PE/CT outcome rows and return the exported percentage for control of seizures after exposure. Return the numeric value with exactly one decimal place and no percent sign; do not treat the search filter or the outcome as a safety verdict.

language_gate.method: English whole-query threshold (langdetect >=.95 or Lingua >=.80), plus sentence/span checks. Ambiguous fragments need English context and either English ranked first (>=.35), or English >=.15 with two English function-word anchors. Other confident foreign fragments do not inherit context. Complete bounded English arithmetic clauses use an explicit grammar/vocabulary check to resolve technical-term detector errors.
language_gate.limitation: Heuristic scores are not calibrated clinical confidence. Short technical phrases can be overblocked; mixed-language text can still be missed.
